verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no in-product AI that generates insights or suggestions from CRM data. Connecting ChatGPT or Claude through MCP puts the AI in an external assistant, not inside NetHunt. The 'valuable insights' from customizable pipelines and the call 'summary' are never described as AI-generated, so they are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
